register.title: Registration
register.hint: Registration is open to university addresses @chnu.edu.ua only. After registering, confirm the address with the link from the email.

validation.institutionalEmail: An address in the chnu.edu.ua domain is required
validation.password: The password must be at least 10 characters and at most 72 bytes
validation.name: Letters, apostrophe, hyphen and space only

errors.institutional-email-required: Registration is possible only with a @chnu.edu.ua address. Ask your faculty secretary if you do not have one.
errors.email-taken: An account with this address already exists.
errors.password-too-common: This password is too common; choose another one.
errors.network: The server is unreachable. Try again later.

pending.title: Check your inbox
pending.text: We sent an email with a link to confirm your address. The link is valid for 24 hours.
pending.hint: No email? Check the spam folder or send it again.

errors.too-many-requests: An email was sent recently. Try again in a minute.
errors.network: The server is unreachable. Try again later.
errors.unknown: The email could not be sent.

verify.title: Address confirmation
verify.success: The address {{email}} is confirmed. You can sign in now.
verify.invalid: The link is invalid, expired or already used.
verify.resendHint: Request a new link by entering your address.
verify.failed: The address could not be confirmed. Try again later.
verify.passwordHint: Enter the password you chose when registering to confirm that this account is yours.

errors.password-mismatch: The password does not match the one chosen at registration.

forgot.title: Password reset
forgot.hint: Enter your address. If an account exists, we will send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If {{email}} is registered, an email with a reset link is on its way. The link is valid for 1 hour.
forgot.sentHint: No email? Check the spam folder or try again in a minute.

errors.network: The server is unreachable. Try again later.
errors.unknown: The request failed. Try again later.

reset.title: New password
reset.hint: Choose a new password of at least 10 characters. Every device signed in with the old one will be signed out.
reset.done: The password is changed. Sign in with the new one.
reset.invalid: The link is invalid, expired or already used.

errors.password-too-common: This password is too common; choose another one.
errors.account-not-active: The account is not active. Contact the administrator.
errors.network: The server is unreachable. Try again later.
errors.unknown: The password could not be changed. Try again later.
